goal: CSRF review: state-changing requests protected by tokens, same-site cookies or origin checks.
use: CSRF review: state-changing requests protected by tokens, same-site cookies or origin checks. Use when code accepts requests that change data from a browser session.

steps.note: List the state changes. Find every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE that uses cookies.
Check tokens. Each form and API call needs an anti-forgery token or equivalent.
Check cookies. Session cookies need SameSite and Secure attributes.
Check origin. Flag endpoints that accept requests from any origin.
Report. Each endpoint with its protection, the gap and the fix.
